intent: Implement the supplied sales request using the supplied catalogue.
goal: A usable local quotation demo with stable observable controls.

controls.#product: native select; option values A, B, C
controls.#quantity: number input; first paid quantity, integer >=1
controls.#second-product: native select; option values A, B, C
controls.#second-quantity: number input; second paid quantity, integer >=0
controls.#customer: native select; option values standard, vip, partner
controls.#calculate: button; recalculate without accumulating prior calculations
controls.#subtotal: visible original catalogue amount before price adjustments; for tax-inclusive prices show the extracted original net amount; only one monetary number
controls.#discount: visible total monetary price adjustment, including negotiated-rate difference and discounts; only one monetary number
controls.#tax: visible tax amount; only one monetary number
controls.#total: visible final payable amount; include CNY and only one monetary number
controls.#free-quantity: visible number of additional free units; one integer, zero when none
controls.#rule: visible explanation of selected pricing behavior
controls.#validation: empty after valid calculation; show a visible error mentioning 数量 for invalid quantity, preserve the last valid quote outputs and clear error after recovery

scope_note: Engineering publication gate only. Customer-specific pricing correctness is scored offline after terminal publication and never returned as repair feedback.
